payload.claim: This comment says an agent can force `integrity` to `error` by hiding a Python file with 'a worktree setting no commit shows (BACKLOG item 103)'. After this diff, `export_patch` reads a fresh bare git dir with no local `.git/config` and no `.git/info/attributes`, so neither `core.attributesFile` nor `.git/info/attributes` can hide a file from the diff `integrity` inspects any more; only a committed `.gitattributes` still can. The comment is now inaccurate about one of its two named vectors, and the spec's own 'Out of scope' section acknowledges this but leaves the stale text in place for the operator to fix separately, so the merged comment misdescribes current behavior until then.
